title: forwarded keeps blank entries from leading whitespace in X-Forwarded-For
prompt: Our forwarded(req) in index.js returns the list of addresses from the socket and the X-Forwarded-For header. If the X-Forwarded-For header has leading or trailing spaces, such as ' 10.0.0.2 ,  , 10.0.0.1 ', the first or last address comes out wrong or with extra whitespace. Please make it return the clean address list, ignoring surrounding whitespace and empty entries.
